sessions.feedback: Nothing blocked me this session. Two suggestions. First, get_quotes and the digest show the 13:17 UTC premarket print, but the SPY quote (-1.46%) differs from the news-reported futures (-0.4% to -0.9%), so I can't tell how thin or stale the ETF premarket print is. Showing the time of the last trade would help. Second, scan reports the gap and close-in-range but not open-to-close. A column for open-to-close return would make "the gap was the whole move" instantly visible, which is the key pattern in this regime.

Nothing blocked me. Three things would help. (1) The digest shows the premarket move but not a live read of IEX trades after the open, so a gap-up chase decision relies on stale 13:17 UTC prints. (2) read_page fails on Yahoo live blogs and CNBC, but web_search content works as a substitute. (3) A tool that returns realized volatility and beta of each name versus SPY would help with stop sizing.

Nothing blocked me. Two suggestions. (1) The pre-open snapshot does not show how far each stop is from the pre-market price. A column in get_portfolio with pre-market price and distance to stop would help, because several of my stops now sit inside the pre-market gap. (2) Please state how stop fills work when the open gaps through the stop: fill at the stop price or at the open price? This changes whether I close proactively or let the stop run.

The digest's economic calendar for today repeated yesterday's releases (11-18 data re-listed under 11-19), so I couldn't tell what is actually scheduled today. FOMC minutes are shown as 'not out yet' but were released 11-18. The code_execution sandbox only exposes web_search, not the other tools like get_history, so analysing price series in code requires copying numbers by hand. read_page often returns only a paywall or one-paragraph stub for Morningstar and MarketScreener. A pre-market bid/ask or indicated open price for the stocks I hold would help judge gap risk more than a last-trade print.

No blockers. Two data gaps: the digest has no Q4 gross margin guidance for NVDA, and several news sites (CNBC, livewiremarkets, investinglive) fail in read_page, so the margin detail came from search snippets only. An earnings-calendar field with upcoming dates beyond five days for held or candidate tickers would help, for example AVGO.

read_page failed on CNBC and MarketBeat URLs that appeared in search results, which makes pre-earnings research harder. An earnings-calendar field with the consensus and the options-implied move in scan or the digest would help, because the biggest event of the day (NVDA after the close) was easy to miss: only the scan 'earnings' column flagged it. Nothing else blocked me.
No problems. The digest lacks macro data results, such as the CPI print, which would help.
No tool gives the actual economic data release (e.g. CPI print) pre-open; web search only returned previews. An economic calendar with actuals would help.

summary:
Session 2026-11-24.

Session 2026-11-24 pre-open. Held all four starters (MSFT 5.8%, AAPL 5.0%, AMZN 4.9%, META 4.0%, about 20% invested, 80% cash). No trades.

What happened 11-23: Huang was reinstated as NVDA CEO at 14:31 UTC. NVDA +31.5% to 165.05, SMH +15%, QQQ +7.0%, SPY +4.71% (best day since April 2025). But SPY open to close was -0.3% (724.33 to 722.29). The whole gain was the gap, and my fills were at the open. MSFT closed at its day low (gap +4.4%, close +1.6%). AMZN closed 0.37 in range.

Premarket 11-24: SPY -1.5%, QQQ -2.4%, SMH -5.3%, NVDA -6%, AVGO -4.5%, AMD -5.3%, PLTR -3%, META -2.3%, AMZN -2%, MSFT -1%, AAPL -0.7%. ANT is -5.7% to 82.65, below its $83 IPO price. Williams (NY Fed) said inflation is too high and did not rule out consecutive hikes. The Dec 25bp hike is about 91-97% priced. 10y is about 4.91%.

Why hold: no new news changes any thesis. Stops sit 5-9% below premarket, so a stop-out costs about 0.5% of equity per name. The gap-up-then-fade pattern has now shown in 5 of 5 recent bounces, so I'm not adding at the gap. Cutting would only crystallise small losses plus slippage ahead of a binary PCE print.

Candidates not traded:
- NVDA: 10-sd move, governance and probe overhang, no edge either way.
- AVGO and AMD: semis whipsaw, AVGO earnings 12-09, BNP cut AMD PT 960 to 650.
- GOOGL: no edge.
- TSLA: FSD V15 news priced in after +11.5%.
- PLTR: weak tape.

Next session:
1. Check the PCE 11-25 08:30 ET reaction (core 0.3% m/m expected). Thu closed, Fri half day.
2. Retest plan: if SPY revisits ~686-695 (11-20 low 686.75) on lower volume than 151M and holds, add to MSFT/AMZN/META/AAPL toward 35-40% invested. If it breaks on rising volume, let the stops work.
3. Watch ANT vs its $83 IPO price (AMZN/GOOGL sentiment).
4. NVDA: Huang congressional session 12-01, 10-Q ~12-04.
5. All four horizons end 12-04.
notes:
Session 1 (2026-10-29): Started 100% cash. Bought MSFT, NVDA, META, AVGO, AAPL, PLTR. Skipped AMZN/GOOGL/TSLA/AMD.
Session 2 (10-30): AMZN missed Q3, capex funding worry overrode capex plans. Held all.
Session 3 (11-02): Oct 30 QQQ -3.5%, SOX -7%. Held everything.
Session 11-06/09: NVDA stopped out -9.6% (gap through stop at open on CEO Huang affair / Megaspeed spy investigation headline). Lesson: stops don't protect against overnight gaps; key-man headline risk gaps. Small sizing (6.8%) limited damage.
Session 11-10: Mon 11-09 big rebound (SPY +2.4%, QQQ +3.5%). Did not chase after a big up day before CPI. (QQQ then made lower lows 11-16/17 -> not chasing was right.)
Session 11-11: QQQ +2.3%, XLK +3.2% (CoreWeave rebound). Held.
Session 11-12: NVDA -8% premarket on board weighing ouster of Huang. Did not trade.
Session 11-16/17: Huang resigned; interim CEO Kress. Mon 11-16 SPY -1.9%, QQQ -2.7%. Hawkish macro: 10y ~5.1%, Dec 8-9 Fed hike ~90% priced, Warsh chair. Held META/MSFT/PLTR (~28% invested).
Session 11-18: NVDA printed a blowout; bought NVDA 7% (stop 10%, target +25%, 10 days) at ~159.4. Held META/MSFT/PLTR.
